preuve: Pilot: 13.6 k characters copied for 27 tasks; batch of 155 requests: 28 k characters copied.
regle: No micro-task data passes through my replies: drop-off as a file (tool launched on the PC or file upload), results brought back as a file, only compact summaries read. A payload already sent is kept browser-side (window, localStorage) so that it can be reused by other models or instructions.
source: Observation (pilot 07_microtaches of 15 Oct.): a payload sent to LM Studio by a JavaScript call in the conversation costs as many output tokens as re-reading it.
titre: Transporting the payload costs tokens: go through files
